lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters on the mid-lateral flank, organized into roughly vertical columns and horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with the circular blobs to form a characteristic grid pattern across the mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges along the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient from light edges to shadowed lower margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras are visible swimming in close proximity to the ventral surface and pectoral fin area.
